priorityList: Before Arcane Surge, get to 20 stacks of Arcane Salvo via Arcane Blast
Cast Touch of the Magi after Arcane Surge
Cast Arcane Barrage if you have 4 Arcane Charge stacks, Clearcasting, at least 5 Arcane Salvo stacks, and Overpowered Missiles
On 3+ targets, cast Arcane Barrage if you have 4 Arcane Charge stacks, less than 10 Arcane Salvo stacks, and either a Clearcasting proc or an Arcane Orb ready
Cast Arcane Missiles whenever you have 2 or more Clearcasting stacks (if fewer than 14 Arcane Salvo stacks, or fewer than 6 if you have Overpowered Missiles)
Cast Arcane Orb when you have 0-2 Arcane Charge stacks
Cast Arcane Barrage when you have 4 Arcane Charge stacks and 20 stacks of Arcane Salvo
Cast Touch of the Magi 45 seconds after the first use when it is ready
